source: Owner direct chat after discussing CharacterMovement, Mover and physical reactions
owner_messages_original: Нет, глубокое физическое равновесие не должно быть центральной механикой. У нас динамичный шутер от первого лица, нам важно скорее что бы попадания были физичными и было весело с этим играться
Давай устроим перенос тогда, можно без задачи в мультика
owner_messages_english_translation: Deep physical balance must not be a central mechanic. We are making a dynamic first-person shooter; physical-feeling hits that are fun to play with matter more.
Let's do the migration then; it can be without a Multica task.
decision: Proceed directly outside Multica with CharacterMovement and the complete source GASPALS locomotion/overlay path, selecting Masculine and retaining source rifle transitions and movement settings. Add or adapt Physics Control for physical localized hits, knockdown/death and corpse response. Remove custom deep balance/recovery-step ownership from the active enemy. Ordinary hits should permit continuing combat rather than entering a long balance-recovery loop.
supersedes: The Multica execution route prepared under OwnerStart01. MSQ-121 was created administratively but had no runs; do not dispatch it. Preserve the historical preparation record.
execution: Direct implementation under the existing subscription, max reasoning at standard speed. One production/editor writer and one primary independent technical review; the owner waived Multica, not technical review. Native build and focused source/asset checks, with owner gameplay/motion testing. Preserve sources, historical candidates, owner edits and the retained lobby. Controller commits verified scoped changes locally using the prepared work identifier.
